title: Cusco colonial y la Escuela Cusqueña de pintura
goal: Explore the architectural palimpsest of Cusco, the indigenous painters' guild of Diego Quispe Tito, and religious syncretism.
grammar: barroco virreinal andino, Escuela Cusqueña de pintura y sincretismo de la Pachamama

items: Analyze the architectural palimpsest of Santo Domingo built over the Qorikancha.
Explore the unique Andean motifs in Cusqueño paintings (Harquebusier Angels, Pachamama virgins).
Deploy art history, Baroque painting, and syncretism vocabulary (sincretismo, palimpsesto, brocateado, arcángel).
